description: The file 'retry_wait.h' defines an interface for calculating wait times between retries based on the TR-069 standard algorithm. It includes function prototypes for calculating retry wait durations, initializing retry wait mechanisms, and a utility to incorporate randomness. It also declares external variables for thread-specific random seeds.

methods.name: RETRY_WAIT_Calculate
methods.description: Calculates the appropriate wait time before the next retry based on the retry count and algorithm parameters.

methods.name: RETRY_WAIT_Init
methods.description: Initializes internal state or resources needed for retry wait calculations.

methods.name: RETRY_WAIT_UseRandomBaseIfUnknownTime
methods.description: Returns a time value that incorporates a random seed if the base time is unknown.
